name: Dual Marching Cubes (Counting Pass)
definition: A two-pass algorithm's first pass that counts the number of vertices and quads required for a specific segment ID across a voxel grid, using corner bitmasks and precomputed lookup tables to avoid geometry generation overhead.
summary: The Dual Marching Cubes Counting Pass determines exact vertex and quad counts for a segment using static lookup tables, avoiding geometry generation overhead to size buffers for the subsequent pass.
